text:
ops-bot: 🚨 PAGER: prod-us-west-2 GPU capacity exhaustion detected. Autoscaler failing to add GPU nodes, queue backlog rising. Pager INC-7199. Please ack and follow runbook -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-scale-failure :pager:
lena: acked. I'm oncall. Quick status — how bad is the customer impact? :eyes:
ops-bot: queue_length=27342; avg_processing_latency=1.8s -> now 4.7s; 5xx_rate=12% on /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Spike started ~06:12 UTC.
sam: seeing increased error counts from several orgs (dev/prod). Drafting status page blurb now. Will need ETA for mitigation.
raj: looked at cluster-autoscaler logs: several failures when attempting to create/attach nodes. key errors:
```
W0612 06:14:33.123 autoscaler.go:421] AddNodes: failed to launch instance: error creating instance: AccessDenied: iam:PassRole is denied for role arn:aws:iam::123456:role/gpu-node-role
E0612 06:14:33.124 app.go:98] LaunchTemplate mismatch: requested LaunchTemplateVersion=7 but ASG references version=5 -> instance boot returns wrong userdata -> kubelet fails init
```
raj: summary — ASG/LaunchTemplate drift + PassRole permission denied. New instances are launching but never join because the node bootstrap doesn't get correct IAM/profile or uses older LT userdata which taints nodes in unexpected state.
maria: seeing pod evictions on new nodes: kubelet logs show taint reapplication loop. Taint `gpu-exclusive=true:NoSchedule` being reapplied by nodegroup-operator and then pods evicted immediately after join. That makes autoscaler think nodes are not usable and it keeps trying to add more.
lena: ok, mitigation plan (short list):
  1) Manual ASG bump + temporary removal of strict taint enforcement so pods can land (raj + maria)
  2) Route critical customers to Dedicated/Reserved capacity as fallback (sam)
  3) Quick IAM policy patch to allow PassRole for node-launch path (raj -> infra)
  4) Post-mit: reconcile LaunchTemplate versions and re-enable strict taints with safer rollout (maria)
raj: kicking off ASG scale now: `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-prod-usw2 --desired-capacity 6`
raj: ASG accepted scale request, instances launching (ids i-0a12..., i-0b34..., i-0c56...). Watching cloud-init.
infra-bot: CI/CD: recent LT build failed 06:10; pipeline rolled back LT to v5. Pending manual reconciliation.
maria: temporarily patching nodegroup-operator to avoid reapplying gpu-exclusive taint to fresh joins: `kubectl patch deployment nodegroup-operator -n infra --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"operator","env":[{"name":"DISABLE_TAINT_ENFORCEMENT","value":"true"}]}]}}}}'`
maria: applying patch now.
raj: new instances booted but one still failing due to missing instance profile; investigating attachment logs. Possible cause: instance-profile association delayed because role couldn't be passed earlier.
raj: manual workaround: attaching instance profile to i-0b34... via console succeeded, kubelet registration started.
ops-bot: system: 2 new GPU nodes registered in cluster (gpu-prod-usw2). Queue draining rate improved. Current backlog=8200. 5xx_rate down to 4%.
sam: routing rule change: split traffic so critical orgs go to Dedicated pool for next 45m. Noncritical requests are throttled by 50% to reduce pressure.
customer-success: preparing outbound to top-impacted customers (lists from logs). Will send initial note: acknowledging degraded service and ETA ~30-60m for restoration.
lena: handoff: I'll stay on for mitigation window. If infra can't restore PassRole within 30m, escalate to eng-leads. Next check-in in 10m. :phone:
raj: update: created ticket INFRA-2042 to update IAM policy allowing autoscaling LaunchRole to PassRole for arn:aws:iam::123456:role/gpu-node-role — flagged P0.
maria: re-enabled taint enforcement monitor but with a 2m grace window for new nodes to accept pods. Also added a healthcheck to prevent immediate eviction loops.
ops-bot: notice: scaling events showing fewer repeat add attempts; autoscaler backoff counters resetting.
sam: observed latency trending toward baseline; some long-tail jobs still queuing. Continuing gradual traffic cutover back to hosted pool.
lena: mitigation effective for paging. Leaving incident in "mitigated, monitoring" state. Will own postmortem and timeline. Please post logs/links to any manual commands you ran.
raj: logs/commands: `aws autoscaling describe-auto-scaling-groups --auto-scaling-group-names gpu-prod-usw2` -> verified desiredCapacity=6; `kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep gpu` shows 3 new ready nodes.
maria: noted: root cause hypotheses = LT drift + IAM PassRole timeout + overly aggressive taint enforcement. We'll capture exact timestamps in postmortem.
customer-success: sending initial customer updates now. Will request follow-ups if any SLA credits required.
lena: thanks all. We'll collect notes and meet for a 20m post-incident sync after stabilization. :white_check_mark:
